raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "say to"
  role subject "Andrei"
  role recipient "Mihai"
  role topic "the car is at service"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@a1 assumed
  relation "refer to"
  role subject "the car"
  role object "Andrei's car"
  polarity affirmed
  basis disambiguation

@q query
  select ?owner
  where match
    relation "be broken"
    role subject ?owner's car
    polarity affirmed
  end
